authentication: actual machine service-token authentication for decision API; actual signed/current human sessions for monitoring setup. Not an OIDC token-issuance benchmark.
environment: Go/PG Docker Desktop shared host; fresh decision/screening/case binaries and decision/screening workers; PostgreSQL 16; plain local container HTTP; controlled HTTP model-read and outbound receipt dependencies
limitations: Fictional mechanical catalog and closed-loop clients, not official-source customer traffic or an EC2/RDS sizing acceptance
API latency ends after transaction commit; drained throughput also waits for workflow/outbox receipts and concurrent source publication/rescreening
100ms database sampling and HTTP/SQL observers add overhead; CPU/RSS snapshots are recorded separately
No source rights or matching-quality acceptance is inferred
request_mix: 50% no candidate, 40% exact-name hit, 10% one-character spelling hit; 2 payload fraud rules; all decisions enqueue a workflow and outbox events
